title: 第27章 晚上的袭击
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
深夜，万籁俱寂。

    玉凝手指轻轻抚过宝儿那张小脸，眉眼，鼻子，耳朵……每一处都像极了他。

    “宝儿，娘给你找到爹爹了，以后，咱们一家三口……”

    身后忽然传来一声极轻的声响。

    玉凝眸光一凛，下意识抬手，灵力凝于掌心。

    客房的门被人从里面推开。

    姜怀玉站在门口，长发散着，衣襟微乱，脸色有些发白。

    她的目光落在玉凝身上，嘴唇抿成一条线，眼底压着几分气急败坏。

    “一家三口？你倒是好手段。”

    玉凝看着她，没有慌张，只是微微挑了挑眉。

    “师姐不是应该在客房里好好待着吗？怎么出来了？”

    “你封了我六个时辰。”姜怀玉的声音里带着一丝咬牙切齿。

    “整整六个个时辰！若不是我有点手段，现在还在被封印！”

    玉凝嘴角弯了弯，带着一丝不易察觉的得意。

    “师姐修为高，我不用点手段，怎么能安顿下来呢？”

    姜怀玉盯着她，胸口起伏了几下，像是在压着火气。她深吸一口气，大步走进来，反手把门带上。

    “金丹圆满的修为，比我还厉害，你瞒得真深。”

    “彼此彼此。”

    两人对视，空气里像是有什么东西在噼啪作响。

    “你知道的，你是张帆的……”

    “前妻，和师姐一样，都是前妻的身份。”

    “我不一样，我是受害者，我什么都不知道。而你是主动的，你知道自己在做什么！”

    “结果有区别吗？”

    “我即便和张帆坦白，得到的结果和师姐你一样，那咱们有什么区别？”

    姜怀玉张了张嘴，说不出话。

    玉凝低下头，手指轻轻摩挲着宝儿的被角，声音软了下来。

    “师姐，我不想跟你争什么。我只是……只是想让孩子有个父亲。”

    姜怀玉看着她，忽然叹了一口气。

    “你说得对，咱们都是天涯沦落人。”
content_en:
Late at night, everything is silent.

Yu Ning's fingers gently touched Bao'er's little face, eyebrows, nose, ears...everywhere looked like him.

"Bao'er, mom has found your father for you. From now on, we will be a family of three..."

Suddenly there was a very light sound from behind.

Yu Ning's eyes flashed, and she subconsciously raised her hand, condensing her spiritual power in her palm.

The door to the guest room was pushed open from inside.

Jiang Huaiyu stood at the door, with her long hair spread out, her clothes slightly messy, and her face a little pale.

Her eyes fell on Yu Ning, her lips pursed into a line, and her eyes were filled with anger.

"A family of three? You have a good idea."

Yu Ning looked at her, not panicking, just raising her eyebrows slightly.

"Senior sister, shouldn't you be staying well in the guest room? Why did you come out?"

"You blocked me for six hours." Jiang Huaiyu's voice contained a hint of gritted teeth.

"A whole six hours! If I hadn't had some tricks, I would still be sealed now!"

The corners of Yu Ning's mouth curved, with a hint of unnoticeable pride.

"Senior sister has a high level of cultivation. How can I settle down without using any means?"

Jiang Huaiyu stared at her, his chest rising and falling a few times, as if he was suppressing anger.She took a deep breath, strode in, and closed the door behind her back.

"Jindan Perfect's cultivation is even more powerful than mine. You've hidden it so deeply."

"Each other."

The two looked at each other, and there seemed to be something crackling in the air.

"You know, you belong to Zhang Fan..."

"The ex-wife, like the senior sister, is the ex-wife."

"I'm different, I'm a victim, I don't know anything. But you are taking the initiative, you know what you are doing!"

"Is there any difference in the results?"

"Even if I confess to Zhang Fan, I will get the same result as you, senior sister, so what's the difference between us?"

Jiang Huaiyu opened his mouth but was speechless.

Yu Ning lowered her head, gently rubbed Bao'er's quilt with her fingers, and her voice softened.

"Senior sister, I don't want to argue with you. I just... just want the child to have a father."

Jiang Huaiyu looked at her and suddenly sighed.

"You're right, we are all fallen people in the world."
